headline: Lamar Jackson Questionable With High Ankle Sprain
summary: The Ravens have been without star quarterback Lamar Jackson for the past two games with what the team had been calling an ankle sprain. According to Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic, though, Baltimore’s medical staff told Jackson today that he has a high ankle sprain. headline: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds (chest) out for year, source says
summary: Giants linebacker Tremaine Edmunds will miss the rest of the season with a torn chest muscle, a source told ESPN's Jordan Raanan. Edmunds leads the team with 50 tackles and wears the green dot to make the calls on defense.

headline: Giants DE Chauncey Golston Out For Season
summary: The Giants received a pair of tough injury updates heading into the weekend. After receiving confirmation that starting linebacker Tremaine Edmunds would miss the remainder of the season with a torn muscle in his chest, the team also found out today that defensive end Chauncey Golston would join him, per ESPN’s Jordan Raanan. headline: Without tight end Cole Kmet, Bears may run more jumbo six-lineman formations
summary: Bears tight end Cole Kmet suffered a season-ending knee injury on Thursday night, and the Bears' plan for replacing him could entail putting more offensive linemen on the field.
